pages.title: Fall Cushion
pages.text: §lMax Level:§r II$(br2)§lApplicable to:§r Boots$(br2)§lEffect:§r Fall damage is reduced by 50% (75% at level II). Landing after a fall of more than 3 blocks creates a shockwave that knocks back nearby creatures (level I: 3 blocks, strength 1.0; level II: 5 blocks, strength 2.0).$(br2)§lConflicts:§r Elegant Catwalk$(br2)§lObtained via:§r Enchanting table, loot chests, villager trades
